statement: Let n = len(words) and let m = max({len(words[i]) | 0 <= i < n}). The function returns a result r and r = true if and only if, for every integer k with 0 <= k < max(n, m), the row string Row(k) equals the column string Col(k), where Row(k) is the byte sequence words[k][0], words[k][1], ..., words[k][len(words[k])-1] when k < n, and is the empty sequence when k >= n, and Col(k) is the byte sequence consisting of words[i][k], in increasing order of i, for exactly those i with 0 <= i < n and k < len(words[i]). Equality of these sequences means they have the same length and equal bytes in every position.
preconditions: 1 <= len(words) <= 500; for every i with 0 <= i < len(words), 1 <= len(words[i]) <= 500; and every byte words[i][j] with 0 <= j < len(words[i]) is a lowercase English letter (ASCII code 97 through 122).

statement: For every input satisfying the preconditions, the function returns a result r; it does not fail, panic, or overflow.
preconditions: 1 <= len(words) <= 500; for every i with 0 <= i < len(words), 1 <= len(words[i]) <= 500; and every byte words[i][j] with 0 <= j < len(words[i]) is a lowercase English letter (ASCII code 97 through 122).

statement: Whenever valid_word_square(words) returns true, then for every i with 0 <= i < len(words) and every j with 0 <= j < len(words[i]), we have j < len(words), i < len(words[j]), and words[i][j] = words[j][i].
preconditions: 1 <= len(words) <= 500; for every i with 0 <= i < len(words), 1 <= len(words[i]) <= 500; and every byte words[i][j] with 0 <= j < len(words[i]) is a lowercase English letter (ASCII code 97 through 122).

statement: Whenever valid_word_square(words) returns true, then for every k with 0 <= k < len(words), the length len(words[k]) equals the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(words) and k < len(words[i]).
preconditions: 1 <= len(words) <= 500; for every i with 0 <= i < len(words), 1 <= len(words[i]) <= 500; and every byte words[i][j] with 0 <= j < len(words[i]) is a lowercase English letter (ASCII code 97 through 122).

statement: Whenever valid_word_square(words) returns false, there exist integers i and j such that 0 <= i < len(words), 0 <= j < len(words[i]), and either (j >= len(words)), or (j < len(words) and i >= len(words[j])), or (j < len(words) and i < len(words[j]) and words[i][j] != words[j][i]).
preconditions: 1 <= len(words) <= 500; for every i with 0 <= i < len(words), 1 <= len(words[i]) <= 500; and every byte words[i][j] with 0 <= j < len(words[i]) is a lowercase English letter (ASCII code 97 through 122).

statement: If there exists an index i with 0 <= i < len(words) such that len(words[i]) > len(words), then the function returns a result r and r = false.
preconditions: 1 <= len(words) <= 500; for every i with 0 <= i < len(words), 1 <= len(words[i]) <= 500; and every byte words[i][j] with 0 <= j < len(words[i]) is a lowercase English letter (ASCII code 97 through 122).

statement: If len(words[0]) != len(words), then the function returns a result r and r = false.
preconditions: 1 <= len(words) <= 500; for every i with 0 <= i < len(words), 1 <= len(words[i]) <= 500; and every byte words[i][j] with 0 <= j < len(words[i]) is a lowercase English letter (ASCII code 97 through 122).
